install_note: Installs @mermaid-js/mermaid-cli (mmdc) globally via npm. Its install fetches a Puppeteer-managed Chrome and headless shell (about 570 MB unpacked on a Mac) into the bot user's own cache, fetched again as that user after npm (utils/puppeteer_browsers.py). The archify HTML maps need only Node 18+ (no npm packages) and reuse that Chromium for their PNG preview.
